title: Degrading
summary: DEGRADING, participle present tense 1. Reducing in rank; depriving of honors or offices; reducing in value or estimation; lowering. 2. adjective Dishonoring; disgracing the character; as degrading obs

inlines.v: DEGRADING, participle present tense 1. Reducing in rank; depriving of honors or offices; reducing in value or estimation; lowering. 2. adjective Dishonoring; disgracing the character; as degrading obsequiousness. The inordinate love of money and of fame are base and degrading passions.
